source_read: https://www.auntieannes.co.uk/menu/ (menu page, menu sitemap and all 127 item pages /menu/<slug>/, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, one request per second; auntieannes.co.uk robots.txt disallows nothing)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published for this chain (40 of 183 option rows have no allergen data on the pages, so the chain gets the guide link only), so there was nothing to compare; whether the figures are per item or per 100 g is not printed on the pages (the script's reasoning, that they scale with size and add up to whole items, still holds)
notes: Fresh pages re-run through aunties_anne.py give the same items.csv, holdback.csv and allergen_guide.csv as data/source (rows in a different order only, because the site's menu sitemap was rewritten on 8 Oct; chain.csv would only change the quoted sitemap date, so data/source was left as is; images.csv untouched). Independent read: each saved page opened in headless Chromium with the page's own jQuery, every size/count/type button clicked and the Nutrition tab the page itself then shows read from the DOM (not the script's variantData parse): all 183 published rows (every option of every dish, 13 of them held back) match items.csv on kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, fibre, sugars, protein and salt. The 13 existing hold-backs (31,043 kcal chocolate milkshakes, halal chicken dogs, rum and raisin shakes, sausage buns, Harrisons dip) are still exactly what the pages print. Vegetarian tags match the page's Vegetarian/Vegan flags except Vegetarian Pizza (tagged from its own name; the page prints no flag). No audit flags to review.
